india.one_line: Sarvam AI launched Token Factory hosting Chinese models, while Indian startups secured funding and faced rising security incidents.

themes.title: Sarvam AI launches Chinese models on Indian GPUs
themes.text: Sarvam AI launched Token Factory, hosting six Chinese models on Indian GPUs despite receiving a government subsidy to build indigenous foundation models.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI launches Token Factory hosting mostly Chinese models on Indian GPUs, reigniting sovereign AI debate

themes.title: Indian AI startups secure new funding
themes.text: Soket AI raised $4 million for foundation model research, Humyn Labs secured $47 million for robotics training data, and Botsync raised $11 million for industrial automation.

stories.headline: Soket AI raises $4 Mn from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant Technologies
Humyn Labs raises $47 million to supply robot training data to U.S. AI developers
Botsync raises $11 million to expand industrial automation

themes.title: AI security incidents impact Indian organizations
themes.text: A ServiceNow survey revealed 92 percent of Indian organisations faced AI agent security incidents, while hackers diverted Rs 65 crore from Delhi-NCR NBFCs using malware and suspected AI.

stories.headline: 92% of Indian organisations hit by AI agent security incidents, survey shows
AI-assisted hackers breach Delhi-NCR NBFCs and divert Rs 65 cr
